title: Fix Font Aliasing - Increase Edge Blur
description: The default font is showing aliasing artifacts. The MSDF (Multi-channel Signed Distance Field) font rendering needs increased edge blur/smoothing to reduce harsh aliasing on text edges.
definition-of-done: Text renders with smooth anti-aliased edges. No visible aliasing artifacts at normal viewing sizes.
testing-plan: Run application and inspect text at various sizes. Compare before/after screenshots. Verify text remains crisp but smooth.
todos: Locate font shader (likely in glsl/ folder)
Increase the smoothstep range or edge blur parameter
Adjust MSDF threshold/range values if needed
Test with different font sizes to ensure quality
unknowns: Optimal blur value that balances sharpness and smoothness
Whether the issue is in shader or font atlas generation
